name: Neo Message
description: Encrypted and time-locked messaging on Neo X. Send a message only the recipient can read, or seal one that unlocks on-chain at a future time — secured by the Morpheus confidential oracle.
description_zh: Neo X 上的加密与定时解锁消息。发送仅收件人可读的消息，或封存一条在未来于链上解锁的消息——由 Morpheus 机密预言机保护。

operation_panel.title: Neo Message
operation_panel.subtitle: Compose, open, reveal, and recover messages inside the sealed-mail workspace.

oracle.description: Morpheus supplies the X25519 encryption key, verifies recipient wallet proofs for private opens, and completes public time-locked reveals.

aa.description: Neo Message uses direct Neo X wallet transactions; abstract-account relay is not part of this release.
